## Problem

Users in the claims and reports modules hit repeated failures when they try to save data, forcing retries and disrupting critical workflow steps.

## Who is affected

- Cindermill Trade Cover, an account with 210000.0 GBP in ARR, shows a save failure in reports [i:53a0a8246321d967].
- Duncastle Auto, an account with 80000.0 GBP in ARR, shows a save failure in claims [i:70c5aa1266521193].
- Merrow Vale Motor, an account with 46000.0 GBP in ARR, shows a save failure in reports [i:89447aec7087b72c].
- Marrowgate Commercial, an account with 1600000.0 GBP in ARR and a renewal date of 2026-12-12, shows a save failure in claim details [i:e0f16662367fc69b].
- Tidewell Marine & Cargo, an account with 420000.0 GBP in ARR, shows a save failure in reports [i:e7aba248526ebedf].

## Evidence

- Across 5 accounts and 5 mentions, all 5 mentions arrive on the sessions route, the only route represented [i:53a0a8246321d967][i:70c5aa1266521193][i:89447aec7087b72c][i:e0f16662367fc69b][i:e7aba248526ebedf].
- Cindermill Trade Cover recorded the sequence "Reports: click \"Save\", rage x3" on 2026-09-22 [i:53a0a8246321d967].
- Duncastle Auto recorded the sequence "Claims: click \"Open\"\nClaims: click \"Save\", rage x3" on 2026-10-20 [i:70c5aa1266521193].
- Merrow Vale Motor recorded the sequence "Reports: click \"Save\", rage x3" on 2026-09-13 [i:89447aec7087b72c].
- Marrowgate Commercial recorded the sequence "Claim details: click \"Save\", rage x3" on 2026-10-25 [i:e0f16662367fc69b].
- Tidewell Marine & Cargo recorded the sequence "Reports: click \"Save\", rage x3" on 2026-10-29 [i:e7aba248526ebedf].
- The affected accounts total 2356000.0 GBP in ARR, with 1 renewal inside 90 days [i:e0f16662367fc69b].

## Why now

- Marrowgate Commercial, the largest affected account at 1600000.0 GBP in ARR, renews on 2026-12-12, and it is the 1 renewal inside 90 days [i:e0f16662367fc69b].
- The remaining affected accounts renew later: Cindermill Trade Cover on 2027-04-03, Merrow Vale Motor on 2027-04-08, Tidewell Marine & Cargo on 2027-07-31, and Duncastle Auto on 2027-08-19 [i:53a0a8246321d967][i:89447aec7087b72c][i:e7aba248526ebedf][i:70c5aa1266521193].
- No cited insight points the other way; every mention captured here is a save failure [i:53a0a8246321d967][i:70c5aa1266521193][i:89447aec7087b72c][i:e0f16662367fc69b][i:e7aba248526ebedf].

</previous_draft>
